rssFeeds.title: RSS Feed URLs
rssFeeds.description: List of RSS feed URLs to aggregate (1-5 feeds recommended)

maxEntriesPerFeed.title: Max Entries Per Feed
maxEntriesPerFeed.description: Maximum number of entries to process from each feed (0 = unlimited)

keywords.title: Filter Keywords
keywords.description: Optional keywords to filter entries (case-insensitive). If empty, all entries are included.

enableSummarization.title: Enable Summarization
enableSummarization.description: Extract summary/description from entries if available

delayBetweenFeeds.title: Delay Between Feeds (seconds)
delayBetweenFeeds.description: Delay in seconds between processing feeds (rate limiting)

enableAISummarization.title: Enable AI Summarization
enableAISummarization.description: Use Hugging Face AI models for advanced summarization (requires transformers library)

aiModelName.title: AI Model Name
aiModelName.description: Hugging Face model identifier for summarization (e.g., facebook/bart-large-cnn, google/pegasus-xsum)

aiMaxLength.title: AI Max Input Length
aiMaxLength.description: Maximum input text length for AI model (tokens)

aiMinLength.title: AI Min Summary Length
aiMinLength.description: Minimum summary length generated by AI (tokens)

aiMaxSummaryLength.title: AI Max Summary Length
aiMaxSummaryLength.description: Maximum summary length generated by AI (tokens)
